service.description: Starts a login at the identity provider of the AuthFlow: keeps a same-origin returnTo, keeps the flow state (PKCE, state, nonce) in the session, and redirects the browser. A failure goes back to /Login.

parameter.name: reauth
parameter.description: A re-authentication (check#RecentAuth): an OpenID provider is asked to sign the user in again (prompt=login)

service.description: Handles the login callback: completes the flow the session started, syncs the UserAccount and its user groups (AuthFlowFieldMap, AuthFlowRoleMap, defaultUserGroupId), and logs the user in locally.
Performs a logout operation both locally and on the IdP server.
The identity providers an app can offer: the AuthFlows the login page shows.

Checks the app's S256 code challenge, its state and its redirect URI (one of webapp_app_redirect_uris), keeps them and the app's name in the session for 15 minutes, and starts the provider's login as login#User does, coming back to /sso/appCode. A refusal answers 400; a failure later goes back to the app with error=server_error.

parameter.name: deviceName
parameter.description: The app's name, shown when the user is asked to let it in

service.description: After the provider signed the browser in for an app (its callback done by the user signed in now): a page that asks the user to let the app in, posting to /sso/appCodeConfirm with the session's token.

The app's code, PKCE verifier and redirect URI for a device key (as the REST login with createLoginKey and deviceName makes), with no session logged in or out. A code is taken once; one unknown, used, expired, of another redirect URI or of another verifier answers 400.
